title: Reaction Library Screening
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Place a 96‑well plate on the Opentrons Heater‑Shaker Module and allocate the central 60 wells for reaction library samples.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate on the Heater‑Shaker Module
Use the central 60 wells for samples

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired protocol parameters in the OT App as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, unzip it if needed, and locate the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware JSON files (.json).

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the deck, tiprack, and pipette (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the reaction library screening.
